units.source_text: 表兄半开玩笑说的“参加葬礼的名人”这句话，使我想起了自己。

en.t: The phrase my cousin used half jokingly, "a famous person who attends funerals," made me think of myself.

units.source_text: 我竖起耳朵听了这句话，忆起了自己的遭遇和过去。

en.t: I pricked up my ears when I heard those words, and recalled my own circumstances and my past.

units.source_text: 其实，我从童年起就参加了不计其数的葬礼。

en.t: In fact, since childhood I had attended countless funerals.

units.source_text: 我熟悉摄津地方的葬礼习俗，一方面是由于不时遇上亲戚亡故，

en.t: I was familiar with the funeral customs of the Settsu region, partly because relatives died from time to time,

units.source_text: 另一方面是由于乡村繁文缛节，彼此都要参加对方的殡仪，

en.t: and partly because village etiquette was so elaborate that families had to attend one another's funeral rites,

units.source_text: 这些葬礼，我都代表家里人去参加了。

en.t: and I went to all those funerals as the representative of my family.

units.source_text: 我参加最多的是净土宗和真宗的葬礼，但也了解禅宗和日莲宗的仪式。

en.t: Most of the funerals I attended were Jodo and Shin Buddhist services, but I also knew the rites of the Zen and Nichiren sects.

units.source_text: 光凭我的记忆，就见过五六次人们弥留之际的情景。

en.t: From memory alone, I had witnessed five or six scenes of people at the point of death.

units.source_text: 还见过三四回人们先用笔蘸死水滋润死人的嘴唇。

en.t: I had also seen three or four times people first dipping a brush in the final water and moistening the dead person's lips.

units.source_text: 也曾按顺序第一个或是殿后烧香礼拜，还常去拾骨和纳骨。

en.t: I had also burned incense and bowed first in order or last of all, and I often went to gather the bones and place them in the grave.

units.source_text: 对于人死后的七七法事的习俗，我也了如指掌。

en.t: I also knew the customs of the forty ninth day memorial services after a person's death like the back of my hand.
